paintings.description: This one is more personal, but we all start out our day getting out of bed, this is mine levitating away.

paintings.title: Phil and me in the Yes rally in 1988
paintings.description: My mom used to take me and my brother to the pro-Pinochet rallies when we were kids. I wonder about stories reincarnated today.
paintings.image: images/Rafael Yaluff - Phil and me in the Yes rally in 1988 .jpg

paintings.title: Pregnant Anna
paintings.description: Venus surrounded by the unforgiving solar winds, sunset fades, words burn, I see her through fear. She carries everything I don’t understand, the weight of a future bigger than me.

paintings.title: Kingdom
paintings.description: Finding time to look at flowers within tar and ripped out political posters

paintings.title: Hide it under your tongue
paintings.description: In the insane asylum, when forced to take the pill. Hide it under your tongue, then spit it out at your reflection mirror.
paintings.image: images/Hide it under your tongue - Rafael Yaluff.jpg

paintings.title: Mapa sadomasoquista
paintings.description: Bruises draw maps on San Marzano tomatoes that disappear.
paintings.image: images/Rafael Yaluff SM MAP RAFAEL YALUFF copy.jpg

paintings.title: Traffic light & birthing
paintings.medium: Oil and epoxy molds on canvas
paintings.description: Hunger on green, hunger on red. If turned around, images of birth.

paintings.title: The house that Raf built
paintings.description: An architectural metaphor for personal identity: Parrodical depiction of the psycho-killer movie (The House that Jack Built) - But really about the bloody bunker within.
paintings.image: images/Rafael Yaluff - The house that Raf built.jpg

paintings.title: Academic Rite
paintings.description: An exploration of academic traditions, power struggles within, and their impact on creative expression.

paintings.title: Lumpenproletariat
paintings.description: Worker, bad worker, traitor worker? fleshy struggle, Kafkian transformation through judging perspective.

paintings.title: Alien Flag
paintings.description: An known symbol turned otherworldly, exploring themes of belonging and foreign identity.
paintings.image: images/Rafael Yaluff_Alien Flag_2021_Oil and acrylic on canvas_66x85in.jpg

paintings.title: Your momentum friend
paintings.description: You know when we were kids we thought meeting someone special could change our lives? Here is my magic person, glowing, emerging from towers of street trash bags.

paintings.title: Promises of silence
paintings.description: A desire to scream freedom, burns deep inside of me, in every conversation, taking away my posible friends, a hymn of freedom like drums like bells, strips me from fear, sets me alone, the next day I mourn, making future promises of silence, until I regain strength one more.

paintings.title: Methadone
paintings.description: Flowers glow bright against a black void, sedate me, suspend me, anesthesia after love.

paintings.title: Gardener
paintings.description: Pastoral spring Sunday, operating conceptual machinery, passing through in leather black, family memories of embrace now self provide
paintings.image: images/Rafael Yaluff_Gardener_2019_Oil and acrylic on canvas_67x67in.jpg
